name: The Evolving World: Catalyst Wake
source:
Only 3000 humans remain after three apocalyptic events, referred to as the "Catalysts", severely decreased the population.

Catalyst One resulted in the air being toxic to breathe, so everyone wears masks.

After the collapse of the government, various organizations have formed, and fight each other for territory and resources.

Oliver Naut is a scrappy kid who has grown up alone in the Deadzones — the most toxic areas on the planet — with nothing but the robotic swords in his arms for protection.

But now he's teamed up with Namo, a skilled ex-assassin, to prevent an army of robotic soldiers from falling into the hands of the organizations, who will only use them for more violence and death.

Will Oliver be able to bring humanity together to fight for peace instead?

The Evolving World: Catalyst Wake is a continuation of a series of animations and comics that were released between 2011 and 2016 that will finally conclude the story.

[From [url=https://lockedon.itch.io/tewcw]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在被称为“催化剂”的三场世界末日事件之后，人口严重减少，只剩下3000人。

催化剂一号导致空气有毒，无法呼吸，所以每个人都戴着口罩。

政府垮台后，各种组织纷纷成立，互相争夺领土和资源。

奥利弗·诺特（Oliver Naut）是一个斗志旺盛的孩子，他独自在死亡地带（地球上毒性最强的地区）长大，除了怀里的机器人剑提供保护外，什么也没有。

但现在他与熟练的前刺客纳莫联手，阻止一支机器人士兵大军落入这些组织手中，这些组织只会利用他们制造更多暴力和死亡。

奥利弗能否将人类团结起来，为和平而战？

《进化的世界：催化剂觉醒》是2011年至2016年间发行的一系列动画和漫画的续作，最终将结束这个故事。

[来自[url=https://lockedon.itch.io/tewcw]itch.io[/url]]
